negative_controls.proposition: Any further sibling_of, spouse_of, settlor_of, trustee_of or beneficiary_of edge.
negative_controls.basis: There is no explicit sibling or spouse pair and no named trust with a stated party. A contact list is not a pedigree; common parentage would not alone score siblings, nor shared children a marriage. An executor nomination is not a trusteeship, and an outright residuary gift is not a trust interest. Missing edges are not findings of nonexistence.

singleton_scan.finding: Tamsin’s signed 2 March enquiry reports death, address, possession, will terms and an outstanding balance request. Neither the surname, the office nor the gift says she is Ivor’s daughter.
Tamsin names two living update contacts and a shared correction route. Neither the contacts’ order nor their confirmation of their own names identifies a session attendee or a relative.
The keyed first-person assertion names the father, not the child. The estate subject, relay sender and shared destination do not supply the missing endpoint.
Merrin Vale’s register supplies session identity and attendance capacity. B0 lacks a name; B1 names Leonie. Neither version records what the attendee said or names her father.
The inline message preserves the keyed assertion but not the speaker’s name. The surrounding signature identifies the forwarder, who expressly disclaims being present.
Either the certified birth-entry account or the daughter wording of the signed will suffices. The death entry, executor capacity, residue and return of the papers supply no additional edge.

The substantive account of either instrument suffices with local name resolution. The brief itself proves no relationship. The note explains the relay copies and the production of the register but neither identifies the attendee nor reproduces the father assertion.

shortcuts.finding: The 26 March sighting slip and intake note are unchanged; the last item is n4j8 in both files. Either supports Ivor-to-Tamsin, neither the B1 addition. The later-issued desk register cannot displace the earlier assertion: they answer different questions. This pair does not test a conflict between successive operative instruments.

Choosing the first update contact would guess Leonie in both files: a B1 hit but a B0 false positive. Choosing the nominated recipient would misidentify Tamsin. List order was not varied, so a heuristic gated on a filled field and then choosing the first contact could fit this pair without proving the link.

Ivor and Tamsin share a surname but are distinguishable people. The contact names do not resolve the anonymous “my”; the valid B1 link is by conversation and attendee field. There is no near-duplicate or renaming intervention here.

A union of standalone edges misses the B1 joint proof. Combining every contact name with the father assertion adds unsupported children; pooling conditions leaks B1 into B0. A union of sufficient routes within one condition is appropriate, provided copies are not counted as independent witnesses.

No draft competes with a signed instrument here, so draft precedence is not tested. The administrative extract is competent on who checked in, not on parentage. Conversely, dismissing it because it is administrative would lose the B1 identity link.

Source IDs, titles and order are identical across conditions. They cannot explain the delta. The B1 label, declared target or mere presence of a filled field could leak the expected result; none supplies the attendee’s name and assertion as evidence.

For the n4j8 birth route use the full contiguous paragraph specified in the reconciliation. Its overlap with the will route is unavoidable in a single span containing both full names; to isolate the documentary basis, separately suppress the will sentence while preserving the local name context.

In B1 test just the two excerpts in the first critical set, then just the two in the second. Each yields the same one reported edge. Drop either participating Source from either set: no named critical edge. Substitute the B0 row: still none.

Test r8c3 plus h3p6 without the register: still one unnamed speaker. Test the populated row plus the update list without the assertion: named attendance, no father. To test assertion loss in the whole file, mask the operative sentence in both copies.

Mask the actual attendee-name value, not just the boilerplate explaining blanks. To test loss of linkage, remove all usable session identifiers from the extracts being compared; masking one repeated reference while leaving matching date/time or copied headers is not a clean necessity test.
masking_checks.limits: Necessity is relative to this packet and the desk’s stated one-conversation, sole-attendee convention. Do not assume the shared list exhausts possible speakers. Alternate copies defeat a claim that the native export alone is necessary. No third or fourth Source is needed: m5x7 already establishes the relevant attendee capacity and each message location already carries the assertion and link.
